burst_concurrent_8inst.description: Burst 8-instance concurrent — PCIe DMA contention destroys PegaFlow benefit
burst_concurrent_8inst.root_cause: 8 concurrent DMA streams saturate PCIe 4.0 uplink: 15 GB/s / 8 = 1.9 GB/s per stream, single DMA inflates from 85ms to ~750ms
burst_concurrent_8inst.verdict: Burst is unrealistic workload; staggered/normal serving load unaffected

mla_tp8_deepseek_v2_lite.description: DeepSeek-V2-Lite MLA+TP8 — prefill too cheap for PegaFlow to matter
mla_tp8_deepseek_v2_lite.root_cause: MLA kv_lora_rank=512 compresses KV compute to ~100ms; DMA of compressed KV (~40 MB) takes ~3ms; prefill cost too small to save
mla_tp8_deepseek_v2_lite.verdict: PegaFlow requires large enough prefill gap to overcome DMA cost. 16B MLA model does not meet threshold; 236B+ may.
